# Change plan or cancel

Plan changes — up, down, or off — are available two ways: directly from the plan cards on your Billing page, or through Stripe's Billing Portal. TrustedLogin handles the plan mapping; Stripe handles the money either way.

## 1. Open your Billing page

**Billing** in the sidebar takes you to the plan summary. The top card shows your current plan, next renewal date, and billing email. Every plan change starts from here.

![Open your Billing page](/img/guides/change-plan/01-open-your-billing-page.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/team-subscription -->

## 2. Understand what your current plan covers

Before changing anything, check what you're on:

- **Plan name** — the current self-serve tiers, as of the September 2026 pricing update, are:

  | Plan | Sites | Logins/mo | Extra login | Price |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | Free | 1 | 5 | not available — upgrade instead | $0 |
  | Support | 25 | 150 | $0.25 each | $49/mo or $490/yr |
  | Growth | 100 | 500 | $0.20 each | $99/mo or $990/yr |
  | Scale | 500 | 2,000 | $0.15 each | $249/mo or $2,490/yr |
  | Enterprise | Unlimited | Unlimited | — | From $499/mo, negotiated |

  If your account predates the September 2026 update you may see an older plan name instead — Solo, Team, or Agency. Those aren't offered to new teams anymore, but nothing about your existing plan changes unless you switch off of it.

- **Sites** are a hard cap. Once you're at your plan's site limit, connecting another site is blocked (with a prompt to upgrade) — sites are never billed as an overage, on any plan.
- **Logins per cycle** are also capped, but handled differently: Free simply stops serving support logins once you hit the limit, while Support, Growth, and Scale bill logins beyond the cap from your credit balance at the per-login rate in the table above (see [Buy credits](buy-credits.md)). Enterprise has no login cap.
- **Next invoice** — the date your card will be charged for the next cycle. Changes you make before this date take effect on the next cycle; mid-cycle changes prorate.

![Understand what your current plan covers](/img/guides/change-plan/02-understand-what-your-current-plan-covers.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/team-subscription -->

**Need Enterprise?** The Enterprise card states its starting price plainly — **From $499/mo** — instead of "custom pricing." Click **Request Enterprise access** on the card to fill out a short qualification form instead of being routed to an external contact page. See [Request Enterprise access](request-enterprise-access.md) for what's asked and what happens after you submit it.

## 3. Click Manage subscription

The **Manage subscription** button opens the Stripe Billing Portal. Stripe handles the plan change itself — we don't build our own checkout for it, because letting Stripe own the card data, the tax calculation, and the invoices means one less system that can leak them.

You're signed in automatically — no extra password to enter. Stripe's portal is a different tab; when you're done, close it and your plan is already updated on our side through Stripe webhooks.

![Click Manage subscription](/img/guides/change-plan/03-click-manage-subscription.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/team-subscription -->

## 4. Change plan, update card, or cancel

The Stripe portal has three relevant actions:

**Change plan.** Picks a new plan from the list — effective immediately, prorated against the current cycle. If you're upgrading, the difference is charged now; if you're downgrading, the difference becomes credit that offsets your next invoice.

**Update payment method.** Add or replace the card on file. The update applies to every future charge, including auto-reload.

**Cancel subscription.** Ends the subscription at the end of the current cycle — you keep all the features you're paying for until the date your card would have been charged next. After that, you drop to the Free plan.

![Change plan, update card, or cancel](/img/guides/change-plan/04-change-plan-update-card-or-cancel.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/team-subscription -->

## Or switch plans directly from the plan cards

The **Choose your plan** section on the same Billing page lists every plan as its own card, with an **Upgrade to** or **Switch to** button. Clicking one changes your plan immediately — a same-plan switch is a server-side swap prorated onto your next invoice, no separate Stripe checkout; moving to a plan you're not already on opens Stripe Checkout for the first payment.

### Monthly or annual billing

Above the plan cards, a **Monthly / Annual** toggle switches what every card shows. Switching to Annual displays each plan's yearly total with a **2 months free** badge — annual costs the same as paying for 10 months at the monthly rate. Free and Enterprise don't have an annual price, so their cards always show monthly/custom pricing regardless of the toggle.

If you already have an active subscription, switching the *billing interval* on your current plan (monthly to annual, or back) works exactly like any other plan change on this page: no new checkout, prorated onto your next invoice.

### Canceling: Switch to Free

To cancel, click **Switch to Free** on the Free plan's card. A confirmation dialog opens with the same guarantees as canceling any other way — you keep your current plan's features until the end of the billing cycle, and your credit balance is preserved (see below) — plus two optional questions:

- **"What made you cancel your subscription?"**
- **"What could we do to make you reconsider?"**

Answer either, both, or neither. They're for our benefit only and never block, delay, or change the cancellation — clicking **Switch to Free** in the dialog cancels exactly the same whether the fields are filled in or left blank. We don't send an automated reply to what you write, but a person on our team reads it.

<!-- No screenshot yet — see the manual-addition notice at the top of this file. -->

## 5. Your credits stay yours

Credits you've bought — through auto-reload or a one-time bundle — stay on your account if you downgrade or cancel. They never expire while your team is active. If you resubscribe later, the same credits are still there and can cover logins against the new plan.

Credits only disappear if you **delete your team**. Cancelling a subscription doesn't delete the team.

![Your credits stay yours](/img/guides/change-plan/05-your-credits-stay-yours.png)

<!-- Captured from http://localhost:8090/admin/team-subscription -->

## Frequently-asked concerns

**Will I be billed on my next card statement?** If you cancel, no — the cancel takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle and your card is not charged again. If you downgrade mid-cycle, you'll see a prorated credit on your next invoice.

**Do I lose access immediately when I cancel?** No. Cancel is an end-of-period action. You keep every feature of the plan you were on until the cycle closes — so cancelling two days into a monthly plan still gives you 28 more days of paid access.

**Can I get a refund instead of a credit?** For annual plans or edge cases (you signed up by mistake, you were double-charged), yes — contact support with your account email and we'll handle it manually.

**What happens if I try to connect a site over my plan's limit?** The connection is blocked, with a message naming your plan's site limit and prompting an upgrade. Unlike logins, site connections are never billed as an overage — there's no way to pay your way past the cap without upgrading.

**Will leaving the cancellation feedback fields blank stop my cancellation from going through?** No. Both questions in the "Switch to Free" dialog are optional and only for our benefit — clicking **Switch to Free** cancels your subscription the same way whether you answer them or not.
